Plain SoupSession default construction: ssl-use-system-ca-file remains TRUE, tls-database remains system-CA-database. No change.

conclusion.rationale: SoupSessionAsync and SoupSessionSync now default to system CA certificate validation (ssl-use-system-ca-file=TRUE, tls-database=system-CA-database) instead of no validation (FALSE/NULL). This is a deliberate security-hardening incompatibility acknowledged by the patch author. Plain SoupSession behavior is unchanged. Patch line coverage is 100% (5/5 executable lines covered).
recommended_actions: Audit downstream applications using SoupSessionAsync/SoupSessionSync without explicit TLS configuration
For affected applications, either configure custom CA certificates via tls-database property or set ssl-use-system-ca-file=FALSE if self-signed certs are intentionally trusted
Consider migrating from deprecated SoupSessionAsync/SoupSessionSync to plain SoupSession
Run PCA-0002 (medium-priority notify::tls-database signal test) with lower min-priority threshold
